data.title: Vehicle tax notice from 2025 (Kraftfahrzeugsteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Musterhafen set the vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for vehicle MH-BK 510 at €186.00 per year from 1 January 2025. The notice is dated 27 December 2024.
data.explanation: This is a vehicle tax assessment from customs. The tax is €186.00 a year, collected in advance by direct debit, so make sure your account has enough money. If you think the notice is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the issuing office. The app shows the deadline. Otherwise the notice becomes final. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
